# guide

The getting-started guide at `/website/guide` — what to do once equin is
running: the first tasks, agents and changes.

A placeholder today: the page's heading, then the site's "more details soon"
note. It owns the `WebsiteGuide.Section` slot the guide will be written into,
so writing it means adding a sub-plugin, never editing this one — and removing
the `WebsiteSoon` note from the pane.

It puts a Guide link in the shared site header; the download page's "Once it is
running" steps link here too.
